title: Grade Band
statement: Implement `solve(score)`. Return `A` for 90 and above, `B` for 75 through 89, `C` for 60 through 74, and `F` below 60. `score` is an integer from 0 through 100. Test the thresholds from high to low so the first match wins.
constraints: score is an integer from 0 to 100
Boundaries 90, 75, and 60 are inside the higher band
hints: The last return is F. You do not need a final comparison.
The boundary values belong to the band whose threshold they equal.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Ordered thresholds are a chain of exclusive bands only if you return on the first hit.

editorial: Ordered thresholds are a chain of exclusive bands only if you return on the first hit. Checking a lower band first and then adding a higher band is how a score becomes two letters. High to low, one return, is the whole structure.
